tbesh_html:
1) to loosen, abide, begin
1a) (P'al)
1a1) to loosen
1a2) to abide (from loosing girths for camp)
1b) (Pael) to begin, open
1c) (Ithpael) to be loosened

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside
strongs_1890.derivation: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of H8293 (שֵׁרוּת);
